topic: How does interleaved array element spacing affect coverage patterns and grating lobe suppression in Ka-band satellite links?
response: Interleaved array element spacing affects coverage patterns by altering beam steering and grating lobe suppression. Smaller spacings reduce grating lobes but may increase sidelobes, impacting Ka-band satellite link performance.
reference_context: Ka-band satellites provide spot beam coverage, allowing frequency reuse. Beamforming and antenna design impact interference and signal quality.
